This folder keeps the package's layout (icons/<name>_<size>_<style>.svg) and only the files the manifest uses, unchanged. No fonts.
tools/New-IconData.ps1 turns them into CodeBase/UI/Icons/IconData.g.cs; the UI-7a tests check that every file here is in the manifest,
that each file's SHA-256 is the one below and in the generated file, and that the generated file is the generator's output.
